messages.subject: Error when running PSCBS
parts:
Dear 

When I run PSCBS segmentation and LOH calling, there was an error.  Part of error message is shown below. I do not know which sample caused this error, which was bad. It had run for several days. Do you know what is wrong ? Do you think the sample we (Henrik) discussed before caused this (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/aroma-affymetrix/FGu8J_44Wkg)?
